Jab tak kaam ho na jaaye, tab tak yeh asambhav hi lagta hai.
Sabse bada sahas wahi hai jab duniya tumhe koi aur banne ko kehti hai, tum khud ki tarah rehna.
Kaaragar bina himmat himmat nahi.
Himmat ka matlab hai, rukna na maan kar aage badhte rehna.
Silence reminder hai: breathe kar.
Chup raho—taaki duniya sun sake.
Himmat sab kuch jeet leti hai.
Discipline abhi jo chahiye aur jo sabse zyada chahiye ke beech.
Dard aur takleef se hi sabse majboot aatmaayein nikalti hain.
Grit kathin hai.
Himmat sakriya hoti hai.
Himmat sab kuch hai.
Khamoshi sabse honest sound hai.
Kaam shabdon se zyada bolte hain, par utni baar nahi jitna bolna chahiye.
Khamosh bharosa natije badalta hai.
Doubt ke bawajood kaam karna—himmat.
Himmat bhavishya banati hai.
